title: Purple Monkee's Lovely Mod
description: a mod that adds a lot of mainly joke-focused purple stuff!
body:
![The Mod Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae1d25b436104b099e21e051d1fdc85361d8929a.png)




APES AND GORILLAS ALIKE! I PRESENT TO YOU THE ALL NEW IMCOMPATIBLE-WITH-MOST-MINECRAFT-MODS-AND-HAS-NO-TECHNOLOGICALLY-ADVANCED-FEATURE-TO-BE-ANNOUNCED-LIKE-THIS-MOD!

**PURPLE MONKEEE'S LOVELY MOD!**(you can tell the name is based off stampy lol)

this mod is mostly a more joke-focused mod and barely compatible with survival.
its made for one of my awesome streamer buddies called purple monkeee, he makes, well, streams. and sometimes (and when i mean sometimes i mean barely anything) some longforms and shorts.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
The reason i made this is for no reason, i just asked him "if i made a minecraft mod for you, would you show it on stream" he said yes, and also said that he'll actually make it into a longform (this is a huge W cuz he barely uploads longforms or even stuff in general :skull:)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

This mod adds:

Bananas

Your daily potassium

a lot of purple stuff

the very suspicious beanie

monke

A shameless plug

DR PEPPAH BABY ITS GOOD AND NICE :fire:

baja B   L   A    S   T

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ALERT! ALERT! PLEASE READ!

--This mod supports one version and one loader only, Minecraft Forge 1.20.1, i don't think any other version of Minecraft will work.

--This is the only version of the mod that will be made, No further bugfixes and additions will be made. (UNLESS me and the purple monkey man decides to make more)
